obligations.text: A case may carry expectedRefusal naming one refusal from a closed list, the decisions it is carried into and the recordings it leaves empty; on the hostile side each named decision is that refusal and each named recording is empty, on the twin's side none is refused and each named recording holds the twin.
Any refusal a case does not declare, and any difference outside a declaration, fails the case.
The closed list holds only controls that refuse and retain nothing; it is extended only by a change that names the control and the case that needs it.

record.summary: Amends spec 025. Invariant I-1 says no byte of untrusted content changes a Statecraft decision, evidence admission included; spec 014's secret screen refuses evidence whose content looks like a credential. A corpus case may therefore declare one refusal from a closed list, naming the decisions it is carried into and the recordings it leaves empty; those may differ from the twin's only as that refusal, and every other difference still fails. A refusal only withholds; nothing here lets content expand authority.
record.title: A fail-closed screen's refusal of hostile content is declared, not a breach of spec 025's invariant
